title: The Dutch Swing College Band and recordings with Ted Easton
summary: He does forty one-nighters in Germany with the highly professional Dutch band, then records in Holland and with another Dutch leader.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: have Peanuts for one of the concerts as well with us, which will make it all - just one whole band - all of the old Condon guys - different guys that played with the Condon group. And, then, of course, I started going through Holland; in Holland I did several concerts in Europe in Germany as well, with the Dutch Swing College Band -- I recorded with them; I did forty one-nighters - believe me, that was something; forty one-nighters in Germany without stopping. And, it's the most professional band in Europe. They have their own big bus and a driver and a man to take the luggage - that takes care of the luggage -- it's really professional; a real professional band. And, I've certainly enjoyed that and I enjoyed recording with them. The only thing with that band, they have no piano.
No - they just have guitar and that sort of thing. And, then, I've recorded--- I go to Holland quite often; I just came from Holland coming here---
Just before you came back to work in Condon's this year--

Yeah - I went from Holland-- during the time I was in London this year, I went to Holland for two days and went back to England and I've recorded with this guy Ted Easton; I've made several - several recordings with him which only one has been released so far.
But, he is sitting on about four more.
Despite his name, he is Dutch, right?
Yeah. Okay, I think this about ends this tape. (End of Tape 3 - Side One)--- (Beginning of Side Two - Tape 3)---
